scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:boundary:test && npm run typecheck:boundary && npm run typecheck:app && npm run typecheck:book
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run scan:secrets && npm run scan:style && npm run lint:ratchet && npm run build
scripts.verify:ci: npm run verify && npm run test:coverage && npm run pipeline:typecheck && npm run pipeline:test && npm run pipeline:doctor && npm run pipeline:build && npm --prefix infra ci && npm --prefix infra test && npm --prefix infra run build
scripts.test: FILES=$(find app lib components tests \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null); COUNT=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -c .); if [ "$COUNT" -lt 163 ]; then echo "test discovery found only $COUNT test files, below the known floor of 163 — glob regression (WS7-011)" >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx --test $FILES
scripts.test:coverage:critical: FILES=$(find lib app/app/api/book/_lib \( -name '*.test.ts' -o -name '*.test.tsx' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null); COUNT=$(echo "$FILES" | grep -c .); if [ "$COUNT" -lt 103 ]; then echo "critical coverage discovery found only $COUNT test files, below the known floor of 103" >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx --test $FILES
scripts.test:coverage: c8 npm run test:coverage:critical && npm run coverage:inventory
scripts.test:integration: FILES=$(find app lib tests -name '*.itest.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'); if [ -z "$FILES" ]; then echo 'no integration test files found' >&2; exit 1; fi; tsx --test $FILES
